The title page of the First Quarto (a 1597 edition) explicitly states that the play is "By the Author, W. Shakespeare". This confirms that Shakespeare wrote the play.

Additionally, the language and style used by Shakespeare in Romeo and Juliet are consistent with his other works from the same time period, which can be found in various literary sources such as the Oxford English Dictionary.

Outside of the title page, the fact that the play is a tragic romance written for the English stage provides strong evidence that it was written by Shakespeare.
